decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel draws directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication knowledge and anchors its binding mobile communication strategy, so in-house R&D can keep improving it.
Mobile PDF signing supports the online contract signing direction and stays close to existing know-how, though as a narrow feature it may be merged into the broader identity suite.
The email-to-app robot builds on secure messaging competence, but its niche use and weak market signals since 2018 make rework or withdrawal fairly likely, so it is kept under review.
The payment compliance suite uses the firm's cryptography and regulatory expertise for ongoing PSD2 and payment security demand, though its compliance-specific scope may lead to repackaging.
